questions.stemHtml: A 70-year-old male with a history of long-standing myopia and open-angle glaucoma presents with a Goldmann visual field documenting the defect depicted in the Image to the I4e copter in the right eye. When he returns with a deteriorated visual field one year later, the most likely form of deterioration is?

options.label: D
options.text: Encroachment of the defect toward fixation
